newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Miners in the Jiu Valley coal fields have started the tenth day of a pay strike on Friday. More than 7,000 protesters gathered in their Petrosani stronghold for the outcome talks between their leaders and government officials, initially due to start at mid-day in nearby Deva.
Jiu Valley miners' union leader Romeo Beja has demanded that negotiations be conducted only in Petrosani.
* The government should focus on the safety of mining and the sector's reconversion this year, said members of the Socialist Democratic Party (PSDR), a junior member of the ruling coalition.
They said the PSDR was against pay rises for the Jiu Valley miners, which would affect the whole Romanian population.

* The country's main opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) started a national conference, amid plans to restructure and elect new leaders. Ex-president Ion Iliescu read a report on the party's performance and its plans for an alternative to the centrist government.
* The leader of the nationalist Greater Romania Party, Corneliu Vadim Tudor, and a representative of the National Unity Party attend the PDSR conference.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea -- on a week-long visit to Washington -- met U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and discussed boosting bilateral relations and NATO enlargement.
